body:
weed pizza
I have tried smoking weed many times before to no effect. I tried it again the other day, smoking 2 joints at about 7pm. After a while I still felt no effects, so at about 8pm I ate some pizza which to which I had added a bit (maybe 2tbsp) chopped weed leaves and bud. Nothing happened. 2 hours later in the car with my parents myhead started feeling weird. My eyelids felt like they were being heavily shoved down and my nose went numb. For the rest of the night I was very high and it was awesome. I moved really weirdly and when I finally decided to go to bed (after staggering slightly to the kitchen for some corn chips and water) I turned a lamp on and stared at my hands for a while. For nearly the whole next day I could feel it and I thought weird stuff was funny that wasnt.
Anyway it was an awesome experience and id do it again. I prefer not smoking, but eating weed.
